text.Timeless Living ─今も未来も心地よい暮らし─ への想い: Timeless Living — why we build for a home that is comfortable now and in years to come
text.数十年と住み続けられるはずの良質なマンションの多くが、内装や設備が古いという理由: Many well-built apartments that should last for decades lose their appeal and their value, and are given up on, for no better reason than dated interiors and fittings. Having spent years in apartment construction, we found that hard to watch.
text.永く住み継ぐための住まいを求め続け、私たちが辿り着いたのは、漆喰や無垢の床材、石: Looking for a home that could be lived in and handed on for a long time, what we arrived at was the strength of natural materials — lime plaster, solid timber flooring, stone — the materials Japan has built with since ancient times.
text.本物の素材こそが持つ自然の色彩、温かみのある手触りや調湿効果は、人の五感に触れ、: The natural colour of a real material, its warmth under the hand, the way it takes up and gives back moisture — these reach the senses. Together with a plan that draws in the view, the light, the humidity and the air, they bring a calm into everyday life.
text.また、自ずと家具の配置が決まってしまうお仕着せのマンションプランではなく、自由さ: And rather than the ready-made apartment plan in which the furniture can only go in one place, we aim for a layout with room to move: one that lets you feel the four seasons, with an entrance arranged so that a guest can be properly received.
text.日常生活を愉しむための住空間であることが、本当の豊かな住まいだと考えます。礼節を: A home is truly rich, we believe, when it is a place to enjoy ordinary days. What we give form to is a sense of beauty born of kindness — the kindness of a people who have valued courtesy and cared for the natural world.
text.都心のコンパクトなマンションで『やすらぎ』と『やさしさ』を感じられる住まい。: A home in a compact city apartment where you feel calm, and feel cared for.
text.それが私共のマンションリフォームの特徴です。: That is what sets our apartment renovation apart.
